use IO.Std
use default

union Node is
    EMPTY
    LEAF(kind: string, value: string)
    BRANCH(kind: string, left: Node, right: Node)
si

load(lines: LIST[string], cursor: LIST[int]) -> Node is
    let line = lines[cursor[0]]
    cursor[0] = cursor[0] + 1

    if line =~ ";" then
        return Node.EMPTY
    fi

    let kind = line.split([' '])[0]

    if kind =~ "Identifier" \/ kind =~ "Integer" \/ kind =~ "String" then
        return Node.LEAF(kind, line[kind.length..<0].trim())
    fi

    let left = load(lines, cursor)
    let right = load(lines, cursor)

    return Node.BRANCH(kind, left, right)
si

let globals = MAP[string, int]()

unquote(text: string) -> string =>
    text[1..<1].replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\\\", "\\")

truth(value: bool) -> int => if value then 1 else 0 fi

interpret(node: Node) -> int =>
    case node
    when Node.EMPTY then 0
    when (~"Integer", value): Node.LEAF then int.parse(value)
    when (~"Identifier", name): Node.LEAF then globals[name]
    when (kind, left, right): Node.BRANCH then
        case kind
        when "Assign" then
            if let (_, name): Node.LEAF = left then
                globals[name] = interpret(right)
            fi
            0
        when "If" then
            if let (_, consequent, alternative): Node.BRANCH = right then
                interpret(if interpret(left) != 0 then consequent
                          else alternative fi)
            fi
            0
        when "While" then
            while interpret(left) != 0 do
                interpret(right)
            od
            0
        when "Sequence" then interpret(left); interpret(right); 0
        when "Prtc" then Std.write(cast char(interpret(left))); 0
        when "Prti" then Std.write("{interpret(left)}"); 0
        when "Prts" then
            if let (_, text): Node.LEAF = left then
                Std.write(unquote(text))
            fi
            0
        when "Negate" then -interpret(left)
        when "Not" then truth(interpret(left) == 0)
        when "And" then truth(interpret(left) != 0 /\ interpret(right) != 0)
        when "Or" then truth(interpret(left) != 0 \/ interpret(right) != 0)
        else
            let a = interpret(left)
            let b = interpret(right)

            case kind
            when "Add" then a + b
            when "Subtract" then a - b
            when "Multiply" then a * b
            when "Divide" then a / b
            when "Mod" then a % b
            when "Less" then truth(a < b)
            when "LessEqual" then truth(a <= b)
            when "Greater" then truth(a > b)
            when "GreaterEqual" then truth(a >= b)
            when "Equal" then truth(a == b)
            when "NotEqual" then truth(a != b)
            else throw System.Exception("unknown operator {kind}")
            esac
        esac
    else 0
    esac
